dashboard.heading: My account
dashboard.myForumsEmpty: You have not joined a space yet.
dashboard.privacyTitle: What is recorded about my browsing?
dashboard.privacyBody: The site records which pages you open and when, and links them to your account while you are signed in, so the Athar team can see which spaces draw interest and which pages go unread. Your network address is not stored, no tracking cookies are set, and neither your messages nor your profile are read. The team sees aggregate numbers; linking browsing to your name is restricted to the super admin, every such view is logged, and the link is erased after ninety days.

analytics.privacyTitle: What is recorded, and what is not
analytics.privacyBody: We store no IP addresses and set no tracking cookies. A visitor's address is turned into an irreversible fingerprint that rotates monthly. Visits by signed-in employees are linked to their account; that link is erased after ninety days, leaving only aggregate numbers. Bots are recorded but never counted as visitors.
